name: Motion Canvas
role: TypeScript generator-based 2D animation editor and renderer for explainers
summary: Vite-based tool for authoring vector animations as TypeScript generator functions, with a live editor, a 2D canvas scene graph and audio-synced timelines. Renders image sequences or video from the editor via its rendering plugins. A full authoring environment with its own project structure, not a library for an existing page. Strength: code-driven explainer and diagram animation with narration sync.
use_when: Explainer, diagram and code-walkthrough videos authored in TypeScript
Over Manim when the team writes TypeScript and wants a live preview
Narration-synced vector sequences rendered to frames
avoid_when: Animating an existing DOM page: GSAP with Playwright
Timeline plus composition in HTML: Remotion or HyperFrames
notes: 2026-10-26: headless CLI rendering route unverified; docs describe rendering from the editor UI. Last release 3.17.2 is 2024-12-14.

assessment.rationale: Last release 3.17.2 on 2024-12-14 (about 22 months), last push 2026-07-02; MIT. Distinct code-first explainer niche, but headless rendering is unverified.
